decisions.question: How does the cluster report (Figs 5, 6, 38, Table 3) define the 'correct' crystal cluster when a complex has several ligand copies?
options: Union: any cluster whose centre lies within 4 Å of ANY copy is correct; reach = >=1 top-N pose in any such cluster; precision@1 hit if the rank-1 pocket is within 4 Å of any copy
Per-pose nearest copy: keep one correct cluster per copy and credit a pose against the copy nearest to it
Keep the single-instance definition for the cluster figures and disclose the confound in the caption
decisions.recommendation: Union. It is the only definition consistent with 'RMSD to the nearest of all copies' at the pose level, it is what pose-level 4 Å reach already measures (183->241 rank-1), and it needs one code change (crystal_centroid returning a list) plus min-over-copies in _dist calls at :1107, :553, :579, :584, :614, :624, :944, :966.

decisions.question: How are the native interaction fingerprints for Figs 7 and 39 (and Table 4) re-referenced?
options: Run PandaMap once per record of <ID>_ligands.sdf against the canonical hetatm_cleaned receptor and join each pose to its nearest copy's fingerprint (new crystal tasks in run_pandamap.py build_crystal_tasks :948-970)
Drop `chain` from the fingerprint key so same-numbered residues on another chain match the chain-A reference
Leave the interaction figures on the single instance and state it in the caption
decisions.recommendation: Per-copy PandaMap tasks. The chain-agnostic key would credit all poses, not only multi-copy ones, and 4/143 alternate copies do not share the pocket residues. Cost is about 138 extra crystal profiles, cheap compute, but the report join and the pose-basis audit both need code.

decisions.question: Is the form endpoint (bestfit / Kabsch RMSD: Figs 3, 4, 18-21 triple gate, Table 27) re-referenced to the nearest copy?
options: Yes: compute Kabsch RMSD against the nearest copy's conformer as a new column and swap it into `bestfit_rmsd`
No: keep bestfit against the single instance, since form is conformer-only and copies differ little
decisions.recommendation: Yes, for internal consistency with 'every crystal-referenced metric', but measure the shift first; if no pose crosses the 1 Å form gate the figures can be re-rendered without a caption change.

decisions.question: Do the AutoDock-only exhaustiveness figures (18-21) switch convention?
options: Regenerate under nearest-copy after re-scoring the six additional ladder arms
Keep them single-instance with one caption clause, on the ground that the ladder ordering is an internal AutoDock comparison
decisions.recommendation: Regenerate. Table 8 and Figs 18-21 are read from the same per_pose_metrics.csv as Table 1; two conventions in one file is the Gen A / Gen B trap again.

decisions.question: Where do the nearest-copy values live in per_pose_metrics.csv?
options: Overwrite `rmsd`, `bestfit_rmsd`, `centroid_dist`, `contact_recovery`, `plif_recovery` with nearest-copy values and add `*_refcopy` secondary columns, so downstream scripts (effort :256-257, exhaustiveness :536-537, cluster :863, filmstrip via hub) need no flag changes
Add `rmsd_nearest_copy` etc. and point every downstream script at them via flags (effort has --rmsd-column/--kabsch-column; exhaustiveness, cluster and filmstrip hardcode `rmsd`)
decisions.recommendation: Overwrite with secondary columns. Three of the five downstream producers hardcode the column names, and the yaml column roles ('rmsd gates every <=2 Å number') stay true.
